greeting: Hello! I am Sahayak, your voice assistant. Which government scheme would you like to check? For example, PM-KISAN, Ration Card, or Old Age Pension?
unclear: I am sorry, I could not hear you clearly. Could you please repeat that?
handoff: I apologize, but we are unable to process your voice clearly. Please visit your nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) or call the official government helpline.
scheme_not_recognized: Please let me know which scheme you wish to check: PM-KISAN, Ration Card, or Old Age Pension?
invalid_value: I could not understand that value clearly. Could you please specify again?

TOO_QUIET: Please speak a little louder or hold your phone closer.
Your voice was very soft. Could you please speak a bit louder?
I had trouble hearing you. Please speak up slightly.
TOO_NOISY: There seems to be background noise. Could you please move somewhere quieter?
Too noisy around you. Please try speaking from a quiet spot.
Background sounds are interfering. Please repeat from a calmer room.
NO_SPEECH: I did not hear any voice. Please speak your answer again.
Are you there? Please speak clearly into the microphone.
No sound was detected. Please unmute or speak closer.
TOO_SHORT: That was too brief. Please answer in a complete sentence.
The audio cut off too fast. Could you repeat that completely?
CLIPPED: The audio was too loud and distorted. Please speak in a normal conversational tone.
The sound clipped. Please move slightly further from the microphone and repeat.
EMPTY_TRANSCRIPT: I didn't quite catch that. Could you please say it again?
Pardon me, could you repeat that answer clearly?
I missed that. Please say it once more.

questions.has_cultivable_land: Do you or your family own cultivable agricultural land in your name?
questions.is_institutional_landholder: Is this agricultural land owned by an institution, trust, or company?
questions.is_govt_employee_or_pensioner: Is anyone in your family a government officer or receiving a monthly pension of 10,000 rupees or more?
questions.paid_income_tax: Did anyone in your family pay income tax in the last assessment year?
questions.has_existing_ration_card: Does your family already hold an active ration card?
questions.annual_family_income: What is your approximate total annual family income in rupees?
questions.owns_four_wheeler: Does anyone in your household own a four-wheeler car or light motor vehicle?
questions.is_regular_govt_employee: Is any member of your household a regular government employee?
questions.age: What is your age in completed years?
questions.is_bpl: Does your family belong to the Below Poverty Line (BPL) category?
questions.receives_other_pension: Are you currently receiving any other government pension?

verdicts.LIKELY_ELIGIBLE: Good news! Based on the details provided, you are likely eligible for this scheme.
verdicts.NOT_ELIGIBLE: Based on the information provided, you are likely not eligible for this scheme.
verdicts.UNSURE: We could not determine your definitive eligibility with the provided details.

followup_prompt: You can ask for required documents, how to apply, or the helpline.
